title: Superset Decompilation
abstract: arXiv:2603.28002v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Decompilation is the task of recovering high-level source from a compiled binary. Conventionally, it is implemented as a series of analyses and rewrites over a single representation, committing at each step to a single interpretation and discarding the rest. We argue this premature commitment is why decompilers struggle to produce compilable output on whole real-world programs, which is necessary for further testing. Compilation is many-to-one: a single binary may admit many source programs, and the evidence that resolves an ambiguity often lies far from where it arises. We therefore preserve competing interpretations when their resolution depends on non-local evidence, while resolving purely local ambiguities in a final solving stage. We formalize this approach as Superset Decompilation: monotone Datalog rules accumulate candidate interpretations across an IR hierarchy, and a per-function weighted MaxSMT solver jointly selects

translated_abstract: 反编译是从编译后的二进制文件中恢复高级源代码的任务。传统上，反编译被实现为在单一表示上进行的一系列分析和重写，每一步都只确定一种解释并丢弃其余的。我们认为，这种过早的承诺正是反编译器难以在完整的真实程序上生成可编译输出的原因，而可编译输出对于后续测试是必要的。编译是多对一的：同一个二进制文件可能对应多个源程序，而用于消解歧义的证据往往出现在距离歧义产生处很远的地方。因此，当竞争性解释的消解依赖于非局部证据时，我们选择保留这些解释，而将纯局部性的歧义留到最终的求解阶段处理。我们将该方法形式化为超集反编译：通过单调 Datalog 规则在 IR（中间表示）层次结构中不断积累候选解释，再由针对每个函数的加权 MaxSMT 求解器联合选择……
tldr: 该论文提出“超集反编译”新范式：用单调 Datalog 规则在 IR 层次结构中保留多种候选解释、以函数级加权 MaxSMT 求解器统一裁决，从而克服传统反编译器因过早确定单一解释而无法对真实程序生成可编译输出的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Superset Decompilation, which uses monotone Datalog rules to accumulate competing interpretations across an IR hierarchy and resolves them with a per-function weighted MaxSMT solver, overcoming the premature-commitment problem that prevents traditional decompilers from producing compilable output on whole real-world programs.
